Pastebin

A real-time shared clipboard. Create a room and share text, images, and files between devices instantly.

A private room with a random, hard-to-guess name opens as soon as this page loads, and it works fully whether or not you are signed in. Share the link or the QR code to bring in another device, or another person, and everyone sees the same content in real time. You may also type any room name to open it and read along. Editing a room you did not generate needs you signed in (top right).

Room name rules: 1–32 characters. Letters (case sensitive), numbers, dashes, and underscores only. No spaces or special characters.

Note: This pastebin is ephemeral. Once all sessions are closed, the content is automatically erased. Nothing is stored permanently. You can also paste screenshots (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) to share images, and upload text-based files (up to 7 MB). For privacy, keep the generated room name, or replace it with one that is genuinely hard to guess. Anyone who knows the room name can see and edit the content. This tool is provided as-is with no guarantees. Use at your own risk. Do not share sensitive information such as passwords or personal data.
